name: vacuum_cost_page_hit
description: Estimated cost for vacuuming a page already present in the shared buffer cache, reflecting CPU and lock overhead of buffer lookup and scanning.
symptoms: High I/O contention under concurrent load
Vacuum falling behind causing bloat growth
tuning_tips: Increase to reduce vacuum's resource impact (e.g., under high concurrent load); decrease only if vacuum is severely lagging and system resources are underutilized. Always tune in concert with vacuum_cost_limit and vacuum_cost_delay.
